data_fields.name: item_cost
data_fields.donor_constant: per-tech script value (ResearchCost); forced to 1 by RULE_CHEAP_AND_FAST_TECH_RESEARCH

data_fields.name: item_min_turns
data_fields.donor_constant: per-tech script value (ResearchTime); floored at 1 (max(1, time)); forced to 1 by the cheap-and-fast rule

data_fields.name: pool_points_per_tick
data_fields.donor_constant: empire research pool total per turn (not read here)

best_idea: Pace a long unlock with a per-tick spend cap (cost / minimum ticks) and let spare points flow down a priority queue and then auto-fill the cheapest remaining item, so no point is wasted.
decision_why: The per-tick cap and leftover cascade suit a slow server-side skill or perk queue; they do not belong in the duel, and float progress must become integer points on the server ledger.
acceptance: A server test with 10 points per tick and a skill costing 100 with min 5 ticks gives the first queued skill 10 points and the second 0; with an empty queue the spare points auto-fill the cheapest researchable skill, capped at 20 per tick.
